content: AI API testing: Postman Agent Mode, the 2026 relaunch, generates contract tests, load tests, integration tests, and E2E tests across a collection from natural language, Postbot writes test scripts and docs per endpoint. Keploy generates API test suites plus schema and contract tests from OpenAPI specs or captured traffic with high coverage claims. Common pattern: AI reads OpenAPI spec, curl command, or collection and generates assertions for status codes, schema conformance, and negative or edge case inputs.
